mapper.select: SELECT id, title, status, total_quota, remaining_quota FROM activity WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET remaining_quota = remaining_quota - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN' AND remaining_quota > 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, status, total_quota, remaining_quota FROM activity ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
